about: Every rate the panel's monthly running-cost line uses, with where it was read and how sure we are. Read on 3 Nov 2026 by desk research (docs/research/2026-11-phase0-providers-and-accounts.md in the Geometer docs); no invoice has been seen yet. This list of 4 Nov 2026 replaces the one of 3 Nov: every rate of that list is carried over unchanged (each keeps the day it was read) and one is added, geometer.fee, Geometer's own flat fee per running shop, which includes the AI model (owner, 4 Nov). This file is never edited after it is committed: a changed price is a new file with a new date (bundle/prices/<date>.json), and the panel uses the newest. Amounts are whole numbers in micro-units of the rate's own currency (1,000,000 micro-rupees = INR 1), so the arithmetic is exact. A rate that is not in this file is unknown, never zero.

quality.official: Read on the provider's own current page.
quality.official-undated: Read on the provider's own page, but the page carries no date.
quality.second-hand: From a blog, a news item or a reseller's rate card, not the provider's own page. Confirm on an invoice.
quality.assumed: A round number chosen for the estimate, not read anywhere.
quality.conflicting: The provider's own pages disagree. The higher reading is used.

USD.note: The research used INR 90 per US$1 as a round number and did not check the day's rate. Every rupee figure that comes from dollars is only as good as this.

EUR.note: The research used INR 100 per EUR 1 as a round number and did not check the day's rate.

geometer.fee.note: Geometer's flat fee for each shop it counts as running in a month, paid by the builder or partner to Geometer. This is the founding price, INR 199, kept for life by the first 100; the page shows a range of INR 199 to 499 and the later price is not decided. The AI model is included, up to a monthly cap per shop. Nothing is metered: a shop counts for a month when fleet's records show it live on 15 or more days. WhatsApp messages are paid to the builder's own provider and payment fees by the shop to its provider; Geometer handles neither.

whatsapp.in.utility.note: INR 0.115 a utility message (reminders, owner notices) before 18% GST. Meta's own INR rate card is interactive and could not be read; three vendors show three figures, and the research reads INR 0.115 as Meta's base and the others as base plus a provider margin. Confirm on the chosen provider's invoice.

whatsapp.in.service.note: Replies inside the 24-hour window. From 1 Oct 2026 the first 1,000 a month per number are free and later ones cost the same as a utility message. The change is on Meta's developer page; the rupee figure is second-hand. whatsappbusiness.com still says they are free and looks stale.

whatsapp.provider.gupshup.note: US$0.001 a message, outgoing and incoming text, no monthly fee on the self-serve page. The page's table of Meta fees showed 0.0000 and may be a display problem. Partner terms are not public. Gupshup is the pilot pick only if it can sign its webhooks (research, question 1).

whatsapp.provider.360dialog.note: EUR 49 a number a month (regular plan), no markup on Meta's fees. The fallback if Gupshup cannot sign its webhooks.

razorpay.platform-fee.note: 2% of each successful payment. The page is dated May 2026. One line says Payment Links cost nothing extra and another says the no-code tools cost 0.2% plus gateway fees, so 2% is assumed until Razorpay confirms in writing. Paid by the shop to Razorpay, never by Geometer or the builder. Not returned when a payment is refunded.

razorpay.gst-on-fee.note: 18% GST on Razorpay's fee, as the pricing page (May 2026) states it. Confirm on a settlement statement.

model.claude-haiku-5-5.input.note: US$0.10 per million input tokens for prompts up to 100,000 tokens. Cache reads (US$0.01) are not used in the estimate.

model.claude-haiku-5-5.output.note: US$0.50 per million output tokens. It reasons by default, and reasoning is billed as output, so real usage can be higher.

model.gemini-3.1-flash-lite.input.note: US$0.25 per million input tokens, paid tier only (the free tier's text is used for training, which WhatsApp's terms forbid). The page has no date.

model.gemini-3.5-flash-lite.output.note: US$2.50 per million output tokens; thinking tokens count as output.

model.gpt-6-luna.input.note: US$0.10 per million input tokens. The page has no date.

notPriced.sarvam-105b-conversations: Sarvam's price page shows display names only, so which listed price belongs to this model is not confirmed. https://www.sarvam.ai/api-pricing
notPriced.meta-rate-card: Meta's own INR rate card (interactive) could not be read.
